r4.why: Polar deserts from too little heat, warm deserts with max PET and low rain, rain forests draining excess water to oceans in [18],[19].

r5.why: Use for warming vegetation change, life zone shifts in geologically rapid time, extinction, agricultural instability, developed vs poorer regions in [7],[20]-[23].
